validation_notes: An initial cold probe failed before creating test processes because its evidence parent was missing; the launcher now creates the parent and refuses any existing case directory.

The first publication-boundary check found an account-specific absence check in the lab controller. It was replaced by an empty-home-directory assertion; boundary checks and a fresh real-manager probe passed. Recovery control flow was unchanged.

An initial read-only observation helper reused a prior-task PID; the task-start snapshot and actual transport identified the unchanged current media process. Initial failed checks and raw results are retained privately.
The systemd unit verifier returned zero; unrelated installed vendor units emitted removed-CPUAccounting warnings.
No raw runtime evidence or generated test output is included. No commit, push, production deployment or notification was performed.
